messages:
rachel: Heads up — starting ~22:10 eu-west1 p95 token latency jumped ~200ms for hosted inference. Not obvious GPU overload (util ~60%) but scheduler backlog up.
infra-bot: Alert: cluster-eu-west1 scheduling backlog increased. pending_pods=118 free_gpu_slots=7 nodes_with_free_gpu=6. link: https://ops.internal/alerts/6842 :warning:
alex: Can you paste scheduler debug dump? `kubectl get events --namespace=redwood` or `/debug/scheduler/pending` would help.
rachel: quick dump attached:
```
Pending pods sample:
- pod/search-gen-9  : resources.gpu=0.1 nodeSelector: gpu=true tolerations: gpu-preempt=true
- pod/qa-runner-3  : resources.gpu=0.05 nodeAffinity: prefer zone=eu-west1b
```
Most are tiny fractional requests (0.05-0.1) with soft zone affinity.
ben: sounds like "tiny-pod litter" — lots of 0.x GPU requests scattered across racks. Fragmentation is expected: many nodes have 1 small pod each -> can't binpack.
li: ran a packing query, result: 82 candidate nodes with exactly 1 tiny-pod; 14 nodes with 0 free slots but <50% gpu util because of small allocations. `select node, count(*) where pod_gpu<0.2`
alex: short-term options:
- coalesce tiny pods via scheduler plugin (we have experimental tiny-pod coalescer)
- bump minimum gpu request to 0.25 for self-serve runtime (quick patch)
- apply an affinity patch to encourage packing (prefer co-locate by team)
Which is least risky for tonight's traffic?
sam: cost/ops note: coalescing will raise per-node util and lower node counts (good), but if we move too many onto fewer nodes we may hit NVLINK/PCIe hotspots or create noisy-neighbor latency. Need a canary.
rachel: proposal: canary the affinity patch for team=search in eu-west1c for 2h window. If p95 improves and no nvlink errors, roll to whole cluster.
alex: patch to add preferredDuringScheduling affinity (example):
```
kubectl patch deployment search-gen -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"affinity":{"podAffinity":{"preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution":[{"weight":50,"podAffinityTerm":{"labelSelector":{"matchExpressions":[{"key":"team","operator":"In","values":["search"]}]},"topologyKey":"kubernetes.io/hostname"}}]}}}}}}'
```
I'll push this to the canary label in 5m.
ben: Also recommend running the nightly defrag job earlier (it currently runs 03:00). Move to 00:30 for a couple nights to help immediate re-pack.
li: I'll also run `re-scheduler --pack-small-pods --dry-run` now and post results. If happy, apply live.
infra-bot: Scheduled job: affinity-canary -> eu-west1c label=canary-search starts in 5m. defrag-run scheduled at 00:30 UTC tonight.
rachel: after canary starts we'll monitor p95 and `nvlink_errors` metric. If nvlink_errors > baseline + 10 we roll back. tagging infra-ops board #INFRA-1234 :white_check_mark:
alex: note — if affinity patch doesn't help, fallback is to raise min gpu request in helm chart and warn SDK users. That is slower but safer.
sam: thumbs up. keep messages short in thread, post perf deltas. :thumbsup:
li: posting re-scheduler dry-run summary in 2m.
rachel: thanks all — will coordinate roll and update the board. ping me if you see regressions.
